senses.en: in a state of wild excitement or great happiness
confused and restless, especially because of fever or illness
senses.zh: （因發燒等）神智不清的；譫妄的

ex.en: The fans were delirious when their team scored in the final second.
ex.zh: 球隊在最後一秒得分時，球迷們欣喜若狂。

root.note: 犁田偏離了犁溝 → 脫離正軌 → 神智錯亂的

senses.en: to make someone believe something that is not true

ex.en: Do not delude yourself into thinking the exam will be easy.
ex.zh: 別自欺欺人，以為考試會很簡單。

root.note: 把人玩弄於股掌 → 欺騙

senses.en: a severe flood or heavy downpour
a large number of things arriving at the same time
to overwhelm with a large number of things

ex.en: After the announcement, the company received a deluge of complaints.
ex.zh: 公告發出後，公司湧入了大量投訴。

root.note: 把一切沖走的水 → 洪水

senses.en: a false belief that is firmly held despite evidence against it

ex.en: He was under the delusion that everyone at school admired him.
ex.zh: 他妄想學校裡每個人都很崇拜他。

root.note: 被玩弄而產生的想法 → 錯覺

mn: delusion 是堅信不疑的錯誤信念；illusion 多指感官上的錯覺。

senses.en: to remove the magnetic properties of something

ex.en: A strong magnet can demagnetize the strip on a credit card.
ex.zh: 強力磁鐵可能會讓信用卡的磁條消磁。

root.note: 去除磁性 → 消磁

senses.en: a political leader who gains support by appealing to people's emotions and prejudices rather than reason

ex.en: The demagogue blamed immigrants for every problem the town faced.
ex.zh: 那位煽動型政客把鎮上的所有問題都怪到移民頭上。

root.note: 帶領（煽動）人民的人 → 煽動家

senses.en: outward behavior or manner

ex.en: Despite the pressure, the pilot kept a calm demeanor.
ex.zh: 儘管壓力很大，機長仍保持冷靜的態度。

root.note: 一個人如何引導、表現自己 → 舉止

senses.en: behaving irrationally, especially because of anger or distress
suffering from dementia

ex.en: The demented laughter in the horror movie gave me chills.
ex.zh: 恐怖片裡那瘋狂的笑聲讓我全身發冷。

root.note: 心智離開了 → 發狂的

senses.en: a fault or disadvantage
a mark given as a punishment for a fault or offense

ex.en: Every late assignment will earn you a demerit on your record.
ex.zh: 每遲交一次作業，你的紀錄上就會被記一個缺點。

root.note: 與優點相反的 → 缺點

mn: 常見片語 merits and demerits（優缺點）。

senses.en: the end or failure of something
a person's death

ex.en: Online shopping contributed to the demise of many small bookstores.
ex.zh: 網路購物是許多小書店倒閉的原因之一。

root.note: 送走、讓出 → 原指財產轉讓，後指死亡、終結

senses.en: to release troops from active military service

ex.en: After the peace treaty, the government began to demobilize its army.
ex.zh: 和約簽訂後，政府開始遣散軍隊。

root.note: 動員的相反 → 復員

senses.en: to pull down or destroy a building
to prove an argument or theory completely wrong

ex.en: The city plans to demolish the old stadium next year.
ex.zh: 市政府打算明年拆除舊體育場。

root.note: 把建好的東西拆下 → 拆除

senses.en: clearly apparent or capable of being proved

ex.en: The new policy has had a demonstrable effect on air quality.
ex.zh: 新政策對空氣品質已產生明顯的效果。

root.note: 能夠清楚顯示出來 → 可證明的

senses.en: to show clearly that something is true or exists
to show how something works
to take part in a public protest

ex.en: The study aims to demonstrate a link between sleep and memory.
ex.zh: 這項研究旨在證明睡眠和記憶之間的關聯。

root.note: 清楚地顯示出來 → 證明、示範

senses.en: tending to show feelings, especially affection, openly
serving to show or prove something

ex.en: My family is not very demonstrative, so we rarely hug.
ex.zh: 我家人不太會表達感情，所以很少擁抱。

root.note: 把感情顯示出來 → 感情外露的

senses.en: a person who takes part in a public protest
a person who shows how something works

ex.en: One demonstrator held a sign demanding cleaner air.
ex.zh: 一名示威者舉著要求空氣更乾淨的標語。

root.note: 公開表達（顯示）意見的人 → 示威者

senses.en: soothing, especially to irritated skin or membranes
a substance that soothes irritation

ex.en: Honey acts as a demulcent for a sore throat.
ex.zh: 蜂蜜可以作為舒緩喉嚨痛的緩和劑。

root.note: 輕撫使平靜 → 緩和的

senses.en: a charge paid for delaying a ship or freight beyond the agreed time

ex.en: The importer had to pay demurrage because the cargo sat at the port for a week.
ex.zh: 貨物在港口擱了一週，進口商只好支付滯留費。

root.note: 延遲而付的費用 → 滯留費

senses.en: shaped like a tree; branching

ex.en: The fossil showed a delicate dendroid pattern on the rock.
ex.zh: 這塊化石在岩石上呈現精緻的樹枝狀紋路。

root.note: 像樹的 → 樹狀的

senses.en: the scientific study of trees

ex.en: She took a dendrology course to learn how to identify local trees.
ex.zh: 她修了一門樹木學課程，學習辨認當地的樹種。

root.note: 研究樹的學問 → 樹木學

senses.en: a person, animal, or plant that lives in a particular place

ex.en: The octopus is a clever denizen of the ocean floor.
ex.zh: 章魚是海底聰明的居民。

root.note: 住在裡面的人 → 居民

senses.en: to give a name to; to express an amount in a particular currency

ex.en: The company chose to denominate its bonds in US dollars.
ex.zh: 公司選擇以美元作為債券的計價貨幣。

root.note: 給予名字 → 命名

senses.en: a recognized branch of a church or religion
the face value of a banknote, coin, or stamp

ex.en: The machine only accepts bills of a small denomination.
ex.zh: 這台機器只收小面額的紙鈔。

root.note: 被命名的類別 → 教派、面額

senses.en: the number below the line in a fraction
a shared feature (in the phrase "common denominator")

ex.en: In the fraction three-quarters, four is the denominator.
ex.zh: 在四分之三這個分數中，四是分母。

root.note: 為分數「命名」的數（幾分之幾）→ 分母

mn: lowest common denominator：最小公分母，也引申為「迎合最低水準大眾」。

senses.en: to be a sign of; to indicate
to stand as a name or symbol for

ex.en: On this map, a red dot is used to denote a hospital.
ex.zh: 在這張地圖上，紅點用來表示醫院。

root.note: 做出標記 → 表示

mn: denote 是字面意義；connote 是言外之意、聯想意義。

senses.en: the final part of a story in which the plot is resolved

ex.en: The denouement reveals that the quiet butler was the hero all along.
ex.zh: 結局揭曉原來那位沉默的管家才是真正的英雄。

root.note: 把情節的結解開 → 結局

senses.en: to publicly declare something or someone to be wrong or evil
to inform against someone

ex.en: Leaders around the world rushed to denounce the attack.
ex.zh: 各國領袖紛紛譴責這起攻擊事件。

root.note: 公開宣告某人的罪過 → 譴責

senses.en: a paste or powder for cleaning teeth

ex.en: The old advertisement promised that its dentifrice would whiten any smile.
ex.zh: 那則舊廣告保證它的牙膏能讓任何笑容變白。

root.note: 摩擦牙齒的東西 → 牙膏

senses.en: to strip something of its covering, possessions, or natural features

ex.en: Years of logging will denude the hills of their forests.
ex.zh: 多年的伐木會讓山坡的森林被砍光。

root.note: 使完全赤裸 → 剝光

senses.en: public condemnation of someone or something
the act of informing against someone

ex.en: The senator's speech was a fierce denunciation of the new tax.
ex.zh: 參議員的演說是對新稅制的強烈譴責。

root.note: 公開宣告其過錯 → 譴責

senses.en: to use up the supply or resources of something

ex.en: Overfishing can deplete fish populations within a few years.
ex.zh: 過度捕撈可能在幾年內就讓魚群大量減少。

root.note: 與填滿相反 → 耗盡

senses.en: deserving strong condemnation; shockingly bad

ex.en: The animals were kept in deplorable conditions.
ex.zh: 那些動物被關在極其惡劣的環境中。

root.note: 讓人痛哭的 → 可悲的、糟糕的

senses.en: to feel or express strong disapproval of something

ex.en: Many teachers deplore the loss of arts programs in schools.
ex.zh: 許多老師對學校取消藝術課程深感痛惜。

root.note: 為某事痛哭 → 深感遺憾、譴責

senses.en: a person who gives sworn testimony, especially in writing

ex.en: The deponent signed the statement in front of a notary.
ex.zh: 作證人在公證人面前簽署了證詞。

root.note: 把證詞放下（記錄下來）的人 → 證人

senses.en: to greatly reduce the number of people living in a place

ex.en: The lack of jobs threatens to depopulate rural villages.
ex.zh: 缺乏工作機會可能使鄉村人口大量流失。

root.note: 去除人口 → 使人口減少

senses.en: to force a foreigner to leave a country
to behave in a specified way

ex.en: The government can deport visitors who overstay their visas.
ex.zh: 政府可以將簽證逾期的訪客驅逐出境。

root.note: 把人帶走 → 驅逐出境

senses.en: the way a person stands, walks, and behaves

ex.en: The finishing school taught young women deportment and etiquette.
ex.zh: 那所禮儀學校教導年輕女性儀態和禮節。

root.note: 如何攜帶（持）自己 → 舉止

senses.en: a sworn statement made outside of court, used as evidence
the removal of someone from power
the laying down of sediment

ex.en: The witness gave a deposition before the trial began.
ex.zh: 證人在審判開始前提供了宣誓證詞。

root.note: 放下 → 沉積、放下權位、寫下證詞

senses.en: a person who puts money in a bank account

ex.en: Each depositor is insured for up to a certain amount.
ex.zh: 每位存款人都享有一定金額以內的存款保險。

root.note: 把錢放下的人 → 存款人

senses.en: a place where things are stored for safekeeping

ex.en: The library serves as a depository for government documents.
ex.zh: 這座圖書館是政府文件的保存處。

root.note: 放東西的地方 → 儲藏所

senses.en: to make someone morally bad; to corrupt

ex.en: Some critics feared that violent films would deprave young viewers.
ex.zh: 有些評論家擔心暴力電影會使年輕觀眾墮落。

root.note: 使變得彎曲、邪惡 → 使墮落

senses.en: to express disapproval of
to belittle; to play down
(software) to mark a feature as no longer recommended

ex.en: She tends to deprecate her own achievements when people praise her.
ex.zh: 別人稱讚她時，她總是貶低自己的成就。

root.note: 祈求讓某事遠離 → 反對、不贊成

mn: self-deprecating（自嘲的）很常見；別和 depreciate（貶值）搞混。

senses.en: to lose value over time
to belittle or disparage

ex.en: A new car can depreciate by twenty percent in its first year.
ex.zh: 新車在第一年就可能折舊兩成。

root.note: 價格往下 → 貶值

senses.en: a reduction in the value of something over time

ex.en: The depreciation of the currency made imports more expensive.
ex.zh: 貨幣貶值讓進口商品變得更貴。

root.note: 價格往下 → 貶值

senses.en: to make someone sad or discouraged
to reduce the level or activity of something
senses.zh: 使（價格、活動）降低；使蕭條

senses.en: to push or press down

ex.en: Gray, rainy weather tends to depress me.
ex.zh: 陰雨綿綿的天氣常讓我心情低落。

root.note: 往下壓 → 使沮喪、使降低

senses.en: a mental condition of persistent sadness and loss of interest
a long period of severe economic decline
a sunken area on a surface

ex.en: Millions lost their jobs during the Great Depression of the 1930s.
ex.zh: 1930 年代的經濟大蕭條期間，數百萬人失業。

root.note: 被往下壓的狀態 → 沮喪、蕭條、凹陷

senses.en: the distance from the top or surface to the bottom
complexity and thoroughness of thought or feeling

ex.en: The novel shows surprising emotional depth for a first book.
ex.zh: 以處女作來說，這本小說展現了驚人的情感深度。

senses.en: in a very poor condition because of neglect; abandoned
failing to do one's duty
a homeless person without means of support

ex.en: Artists turned the derelict factory into a busy gallery.
ex.zh: 藝術家們把那座廢棄工廠改造成熱鬧的藝廊。

root.note: 完全丟下不管 → 被遺棄的；失職的

senses.en: to express contempt for; to mock

ex.en: Critics were quick to deride the idea, but it later proved successful.
ex.zh: 評論家們很快就嘲笑這個點子，但它後來證明是成功的。

root.note: 居高臨下地笑 → 嘲笑

senses.en: deserving to be mocked; laughable

ex.en: His derisible excuse made the whole class groan.
ex.zh: 他那可笑的藉口讓全班都唉聲嘆氣。

root.note: 能被嘲笑的 → 可笑的

senses.en: contemptuous ridicule or mockery

ex.en: His strange proposal was met with derision from the committee.
ex.zh: 他那奇怪的提案遭到委員會的嘲笑。

root.note: 居高臨下地笑 → 嘲笑

senses.en: the origin or source of something, especially a word
the process of obtaining something from a source

ex.en: The derivation of the word "salary" is linked to salt.
ex.zh: 「salary（薪水）」這個字的起源與鹽有關。

root.note: 從源頭引出的水流 → 起源、衍生

senses.en: imitative of someone else's work; unoriginal
something that comes from another source
(math) the rate of change of a function; (finance) a contract based on an asset's value

ex.en: Critics called the band's new album dull and derivative.
ex.zh: 樂評認為這個樂團的新專輯既無聊又缺乏原創性。

root.note: 從別的源頭引出來的 → 衍生的、模仿的

senses.en: to obtain something from a specified source
to originate or develop from

ex.en: Many people derive great pleasure from gardening.
ex.zh: 許多人從園藝中獲得極大的樂趣。

root.note: 從溪流引出水 → 獲得、源自

senses.en: the branch of medicine dealing with the skin

ex.en: She is doing her residency in dermatology at a large hospital.
ex.zh: 她在一家大醫院的皮膚科當住院醫師。

root.note: 研究皮膚的學問 → 皮膚醫學

senses.en: a crane for lifting heavy objects
the framework over an oil well

ex.en: A tall derrick rose above the oil field.
ex.zh: 一座高聳的鑽塔矗立在油田上。

mn: 源自 17 世紀倫敦一位名叫 Derrick 的絞刑手，原本指絞刑架。

senses.en: a person, animal, or plant descended from a particular ancestor
something that developed from an earlier form

ex.en: She is a descendant of farmers who settled here two centuries ago.
ex.zh: 她是兩百年前在此定居的農民的後代。

root.note: 從家族往下傳的人 → 後代

senses.en: descending; going downward
variant spelling of "descendant"

ex.en: The descendent path wound down toward the river.
ex.zh: 那條下坡路蜿蜒通往河邊。

root.note: 往下爬的 → 下降的

mn: 名詞「後代」通常拼成 descendant；-ent 多作形容詞用。

senses.en: the action of moving downward
a person's family origin or ancestry

ex.en: The plane began its descent toward the airport.
ex.zh: 飛機開始朝機場下降。

root.note: 往下爬 → 下降；世代往下 → 血統

mn: descent（下降）vs. dissent（異議）vs. decent（正派的）。

senses.en: to catch sight of something distant or hard to see

ex.en: From the tower, the guard could descry a ship on the horizon.
ex.zh: 從塔上，守衛隱約看見地平線上有一艘船。

senses.en: a dry, barren area with little rainfall
[dɪˋzɝt] to abandon a person or place, especially without help
[dɪˋzɝt] to leave the armed forces without permission

ex.en: Camels can travel for days across the desert without drinking.
ex.zh: 駱駝可以好幾天不喝水穿越沙漠。

ex.en: A true friend would never desert you in a crisis.
ex.zh: 真正的朋友絕不會在危難時拋棄你。

root.note: 不再連接 → 拋棄；被拋棄的荒地 → 沙漠

mn: desert 只有一個 s；甜點 dessert 有兩個 s（甜點吃再多也不嫌多）。

senses.en: a substance used to absorb moisture and keep things dry

ex.en: A small packet of desiccant keeps the seaweed snacks crisp.
ex.zh: 一小包乾燥劑讓海苔零食保持酥脆。

root.note: 使完全乾燥的東西 → 乾燥劑

senses.en: to officially choose someone or something for a particular role
to give a name or label to
appointed to a position but not yet in it

ex.en: The city will designate this area as a nature reserve.
ex.zh: 市政府將把這個地區劃定為自然保護區。

root.note: 做記號標出 → 指定

senses.en: to stop doing something

ex.en: The court ordered the company to desist from using the logo.
ex.zh: 法院命令該公司停止使用這個商標。

root.note: 站開、不再繼續 → 停止

mn: 法律用語 cease and desist（停止並終止）。

senses.en: the act of stopping, especially of criminal behavior

ex.en: Job training programs can encourage desistance from crime.
ex.zh: 職業訓練計畫能鼓勵人們不再犯罪。

root.note: 站開不再繼續 → 停止

senses.en: the complete loss of hope
to lose all hope

ex.en: Do not despair; there is still time to fix the mistake.
ex.zh: 別絕望，還有時間可以補救這個錯誤。

root.note: 沒有希望 → 絕望

senses.en: a reckless and dangerous criminal

ex.en: In the old western, a desperado robbed the train at gunpoint.
ex.zh: 在那部老西部片中，一名亡命之徒持槍搶劫火車。

root.note: 絕望而不顧一切的人 → 亡命之徒

senses.en: feeling or showing hopelessness and willing to try anything
extremely serious or dangerous
having a great need or desire for something

ex.en: After hours in the sun, the hikers were desperate for water.
ex.zh: 在烈日下走了幾個小時後，健行者們極度渴望喝水。

root.note: 沒有希望的 → 絕望的、不顧一切的

senses.en: deserving hatred and contempt

ex.en: Stealing from a charity is a despicable act.
ex.zh: 偷慈善機構的錢是卑劣的行為。

root.note: 該被往下看（瞧不起）的 → 卑鄙的

senses.en: without being affected by; in spite of

ex.en: The game continued despite the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 儘管下著大雨，比賽仍繼續進行。

root.note: 原意是輕視；「不把某事放在眼裡」→ 儘管

mn: despite 後面直接接名詞，不加 of；in spite of 才要 of。

senses.en: to become discouraged or lose hope
a state of low spirits (as in "the slough of despond")

ex.en: We must not despond just because the first attempt failed.
ex.zh: 我們不能只因為第一次嘗試失敗就灰心喪志。

root.note: 放棄承諾、喪失勇氣 → 沮喪

senses.en: in low spirits from loss of hope or courage

ex.en: He became despondent after being rejected by every college he applied to.
ex.zh: 被所有申請的大學拒絕後，他變得非常消沉。

root.note: 喪失勇氣與信心的 → 沮喪的

senses.en: a ruler with absolute power, especially one who uses it cruelly

ex.en: The despot jailed anyone who dared to criticize him.
ex.zh: 那個暴君把任何敢批評他的人都關進牢裡。

parts.m: master, lord 主人（希臘文 despotēs）

root.note: 家中的主人 → 擁有絕對權力的人

senses.en: rule by a single person with absolute power

ex.en: The revolution ended centuries of despotism.
ex.zh: 這場革命終結了數百年的專制統治。

root.note: 暴君的統治制度 → 專制

senses.en: extremely poor and lacking basic necessities
completely lacking in something (destitute of)

ex.en: The flood left thousands of families destitute.
ex.zh: 這場水災讓數千個家庭一貧如洗。

root.note: 被放在一旁、被拋棄的 → 一無所有的

senses.en: lacking a plan or purpose; jumping from one thing to another
senses.zh: 散漫的；雜亂無章的；隨意的

ex.en: We made desultory conversation while waiting for the bus.
ex.zh: 等公車時，我們有一搭沒一搭地聊著。

root.note: 像馬戲團演員在馬背間跳來跳去 → 東跳西跳、散漫的

senses.en: to discourage someone from doing something, usually by fear of consequences

ex.en: Bright lights can deter burglars from entering a home.
ex.zh: 明亮的燈光可以嚇阻竊賊闖入住家。

root.note: 嚇走 → 嚇阻

senses.en: to become progressively worse

ex.en: Without repairs, the old bridge will deteriorate quickly.
ex.zh: 若不維修，這座舊橋會很快損壞。

root.note: 變得更壞 → 惡化

senses.en: having exact and definite limits

ex.en: The contract runs for a determinate period of five years.
ex.zh: 這份合約有明確的期限，為期五年。

root.note: 界限已劃定的 → 確定的

senses.en: firmness of purpose; resoluteness
the process of establishing something exactly

ex.en: Her determination to finish the marathon inspired everyone.
ex.zh: 她跑完馬拉松的決心激勵了每一個人。

root.note: 把界限劃定 → 確定；心意已定 → 決心

senses.en: a thing that discourages someone from doing something
able or intended to deter

ex.en: Security cameras act as a deterrent to shoplifters.
ex.zh: 監視器對順手牽羊的人具有嚇阻作用。

root.note: 把人嚇走的東西 → 嚇阻物

senses.en: to dislike intensely

ex.en: I detest waking up early on cold winter mornings.
ex.zh: 我非常討厭在寒冷的冬天早上早起。

root.note: 舉證指責、詛咒 → 痛恨

senses.en: to reduce the value or quality of something (detract from)

ex.en: A few typos do not detract from the strength of her essay.
ex.zh: 幾個錯字並不影響她這篇文章的出色。

root.note: 把價值拉走 → 減損

senses.en: harm or damage

ex.en: He worked long hours to the detriment of his health.
ex.zh: 他長時間工作，損害了自己的健康。

root.note: 磨掉、磨損 → 損害

mn: 常用片語 to the detriment of（對…有害）。

senses.en: to thrust or force down or away

ex.en: The powerful current can detrude loose rocks from the riverbank.
ex.zh: 強勁的水流能把鬆動的石塊從河岸推落。

root.note: 往下推 → 推落、逐出

senses.en: to depart from an established course or standard

ex.en: The pilot had to deviate from the planned route because of a storm.
ex.zh: 因為暴風雨，機長必須偏離原定航線。

root.note: 離開原本的路 → 偏離

senses.en: reckless mischief; wicked behavior

ex.en: The twins were always up to some devilry when the teacher looked away.
ex.zh: 老師一轉身，那對雙胞胎總是在搞惡作劇。

root.note: 魔鬼般的行為 → 惡作劇、惡行

senses.en: reckless mischief; wicked behavior (chiefly American variant of devilry)
senses.zh: 惡作劇；惡行（devilry 的美式變體）

ex.en: The boys' deviltry included hiding frogs in the teacher's desk.
ex.zh: 那群男孩的惡作劇包括把青蛙藏進老師的桌子裡。

root.note: 魔鬼般的行為 → 惡作劇

senses.en: using dishonest or indirect methods to get what one wants
not straight or direct; winding

ex.en: The villain came up with a devious plan to steal the jewels.
ex.zh: 反派想出一個狡詐的計畫來偷珠寶。

root.note: 偏離正路的 → 迂迴的、不正當的

senses.en: to plan or invent something by careful thought

ex.en: Engineers must devise a way to cool the new engine.
ex.zh: 工程師必須想出辦法讓新引擎降溫。

root.note: 仔細劃分、安排 → 設計

mn: devise（動詞，想出）vs. device（名詞，裝置）。

senses.en: deeply religious
totally committed to a cause or belief

ex.en: My devout grandmother prays every morning before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我虔誠的祖母每天早餐前都會禱告。

root.note: 完全發誓奉獻的 → 虔誠的

senses.en: skill in performing tasks, especially with the hands
mental skill or quickness

ex.en: Playing the piano requires great manual dexterity.
ex.zh: 彈鋼琴需要非常靈巧的雙手。

root.note: 像右手一樣靈活 → 靈巧

senses.en: characteristic of the devil; extremely wicked or cruel

ex.en: The villain's diabolic scheme nearly destroyed the city.
ex.zh: 反派那惡毒的陰謀差點毀掉整座城市。

root.note: 丟出惡意中傷的話（希臘文 diabolos 誹謗者 = 魔鬼）→ 惡魔般的

senses.en: (of a mark or sign) placed on a letter to show a different pronunciation

ex.en: The word "café" has a diacritical mark over the final letter.
ex.zh: 「café」這個字的最後一個字母上有一個變音符號。

root.note: 用來分辨區別的 → 區別發音的

senses.en: to identify the nature of an illness or problem by examination

ex.en: The mechanic needed an hour to diagnose the engine problem.
ex.zh: 技師花了一小時才找出引擎的問題。

root.note: 透徹地知道 → 診斷

senses.en: the identification of an illness or problem

ex.en: Early diagnosis greatly improves the chance of recovery.
ex.zh: 及早診斷能大大提高康復的機會。

root.note: 透徹地知道 → 診斷

senses.en: a form of a language spoken in a particular region or by a particular group

ex.en: My grandparents speak a dialect that I can barely understand.
ex.zh: 我祖父母說的方言我幾乎聽不懂。

root.note: 彼此之間的說話方式 → 方言

senses.en: a person skilled in logical argument and debate

ex.en: A skilled dialectician, she exposed every flaw in her opponent's reasoning.
ex.zh: 她是位高明的辯論家，揭露了對手推理中的每個漏洞。

root.note: 善於彼此對話論辯的人 → 辯證家

senses.en: conversation between two or more people, as in a book or film
a discussion aimed at resolving a problem

ex.en: The two countries agreed to open a dialogue on trade.
ex.zh: 兩國同意就貿易問題展開對話。

root.note: 彼此之間的說話 → 對話

senses.en: (of fabric) light, delicate, and see-through

ex.en: The dancer wore a diaphanous scarf that floated as she spun.
ex.zh: 舞者披著一條輕薄透明的圍巾，旋轉時隨之飄揚。

root.note: 光線能穿透而顯現 → 透明的
